meta_description:
595K likes, 3,244 comments - tanyakhanijow on March 14, 2024: "Ladakh itinerary for the summer! 🫶 Btw, this was originally designed by @eforeshaan 🙈

Here’s a little day wise detail: 

Day 1-2 Leh 
Day 3 - Drive to Karzok
Day 4-5 Spend time around Karzok and acclimatise 
Day 6-7 Hanle 
Day 8-10 Merak Village 
Day 11-12 Nubra 
Day 13-15 Turtuk 
Day 16-19 Kargil and Suru Valley 

To cut down on days, you can skip going to places that don’t interest you as much or just follow the circuit route! 

Video created on @mapcreator_io".
